record.bible_text: Now after this<WH0310> it came to pass, that David<WH01732> smote<WH05221><WTH8686> the Philistines<WH06430>, and subdued<WH03665><WTH8686> them, and took<WH03947><WTH8799> Gath<WH01661> and her towns<WH01323> out of the hand<WH03027> of the Philistines<WH06430>.

And when the Syrians<WH0758> of Damascus<WH01834> came<WH0935><WTH8799> to help<WH05826><WTH8800> Hadarezer<WH01928> king<WH04428> of Zobah<WH06678>, David<WH01732> slew<WH05221><WTH8686> of the Syrians<WH0758> two<WH08147> and twenty<WH06242> thousand<WH0505> men<WH0376>. <RF>Damascus: Heb. Darmesek<Rf>

Then David<WH01732> put<WH07760><WTH8799> <FI>garrisons<Fi> in Syriadamascus<WH0758><WH01834>; and the Syrians<WH0758> became David's<WH01732> servants<WH05650>, <FI>and<Fi> brought<WH05375><WTH8802> gifts<WH04503>. Thus the LORD<WH03068> preserved<WH03467><WTH8686> David<WH01732> whithersoever he went<WH01980><WTH8804>.
And David<WH01732> took<WH03947><WTH8799> the shields<WH07982> of gold<WH02091> that were on the servants<WH05650> of Hadarezer<WH01928>, and brought<WH0935><WTH8686> them to Jerusalem<WH03389>.

Likewise from Tibhath<WH02880>, and from Chun<WH03560>, cities<WH05892> of Hadarezer<WH01928>, brought<WH03947><WTH8804> David<WH01732> very<WH03966> much<WH07227> brass<WH05178>, wherewith Solomon<WH08010> made<WH06213><WTH8804> the brasen<WH05178> sea<WH03220>, and the pillars<WH05982>, and the vessels<WH03627> of brass<WH05178>. <RF>Tibhath...: called in the book of Samuel Betah, and Berothai<Rf><CM>

Now when Tou<WH08583> king<WH04428> of Hamath<WH02574> heard<WH08085><WTH8799> how David<WH01732> had smitten<WH05221><WTH8689> all the host<WH02428> of Hadarezer<WH01928> king<WH04428> of Zobah<WH06678>; <RF>Tou: also called, Toi<Rf>

He sent<WH07971><WTH8799> Hadoram<WH01913> his son<WH01121> to king<WH04428> David<WH01732>, to enquire<WH07592><WTH8800> of his welfare<WH07965>, and to congratulate<WH01288><WTH8763> him, because he had fought<WH03898><WTH8738> against Hadarezer<WH01928>, and smitten<WH05221><WTH8686> him; (for Hadarezer<WH01928> had war<WH0376><WH04421> with Tou<WH08583>;) and <FI>with him<Fi> all manner of vessels<WH03627> of gold<WH02091> and silver<WH03701> and brass<WH05178>. <RF>Hadoram: also called, Joram<Rf> <RF>to enquire...: or, to salute<Rf> <RF>to congratulate: Heb. to bless<Rf> <RF>had war: Heb. was the man of wars<Rf>

Them also king<WH04428> David<WH01732> dedicated<WH06942><WTH8689> unto the LORD<WH03068>, with the silver<WH03701> and the gold<WH02091> that he brought<WH05375><WTH8804> from all <FI>these<Fi> nations<WH01471>; from Edom<WH0123>, and from Moab<WH04124>, and from the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>, and from the Philistines<WH06430>, and from Amalek<WH06002>.

Moreover Abishai<WH052> the son<WH01121> of Zeruiah<WH06870> slew<WH05221><WTH8689> of the Edomites<WH0123> in the valley<WH01516> of salt<WH04417> eighteen<WH08083><WH06240> thousand<WH0505>. <RF>Abishai: Heb. Abshai<Rf>

So David<WH01732> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> over all Israel<WH03478>, and executed<WH06213><WTH8802> judgment<WH04941> and justice<WH06666> among all his people<WH05971>.

And Joab<WH03097> the son<WH01121> of Zeruiah<WH06870> <FI>was<Fi> over the host<WH06635>; and Jehoshaphat<WH03092> the son<WH01121> of Ahilud<WH0286>, recorder<WH02142><WTH8688>. <RF>recorder: or, remembrancer<Rf>

And Zadok<WH06659> the son<WH01121> of Ahitub<WH0285>, and Abimelech<WH040> the son<WH01121> of Abiathar<WH054>, <FI>were<Fi> the priests<WH03548>; and Shavsha<WH07798> was scribe<WH05608><WTH8802>; <RF>Abimelech: also called, Ahimelech<Rf> <RF>Shavsha: also called Seraiah or Shisha<Rf>

And Benaiah<WH01141> the son<WH01121> of Jehoiada<WH03077> <FI>was<Fi> over the Cherethites<WH03774> and the Pelethites<WH06432>; and the sons<WH01121> of David<WH01732> <FI>were<Fi> chief<WH07223> about<WH03027> the king<WH04428>. <RF>about...: Heb. at the hand of the king<Rf><CM>
